description: A real, minimal road-network data source — a few real city blocks around central Klosterneuburg, Austria, extracted from OpenStreetMap (see scripts/extract_city_roads.py in the main Sotrice repo). Publishes the routable node/edge graph as a bare road_network attribute for anything to consume (agent-behavior-test uses it for real pathfinding), plus a real road_attribution string (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL — real attribution is required wherever this data is displayed). Not the photorealistic-building/3D-Tiles problem — no building geometry, just the road network.
author: prackoreal
